title: spec/i18n: a translation bundle has no key for positions or permission sets, so their labels stay in the authoring language
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible, named landing point, reproduced through `os validate`).

**Business reason.** An app authored in one language (here Chinese, with an English bundle per its i18n policy) ships positions (`positions[].label`) and permission sets (`permissions[].label`). Admins assign people to positions and see "pending on position X" on approvals; in an `en` workspace those labels stay in the source language, while every object, field, view, flow and app label next to them is translated. `os i18n check --strict` cannot flag them, because there is nowhere to put the translation.

**Reach (measured once).** In objectstack-ai/hotsrm (spec 18.0.0) adding
```ts
positions: { srm_legal_counsel: { label: 'Legal Counsel' } },
```
to the `en` `TranslationData` bundle fails `objectstack validate` with `Unrecognized key(s) on this locale of the translation bundle: positions`, and `tsc` rejects it (`'positions' does not exist in type ...`). `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` has slots for objects, picklists, apps, messages, dashboards, pages, flows, but none for positions or permission sets (`PositionSchema` carries only `label` / `description`).

**Expected.** A `positions` (and `permissions`) map in the translation bundle (`label`, `description`), overlaid wherever the console renders a position or permission-set label, and covered by `os i18n check`.

**Who acts.** spec seat (translation schema + typegen), then the runtime/console seat for the overlay.

**Dedupe.** Searched `translate position label permission set label i18n translation` in objectstack-ai/objectstack: 5 hits incl. closed (#25459, #24968, #16251, #7634, #3370), none about positions or permission sets.

Reported from hotsrm issue #22 (session https://claude.ai/code/session_01PZH89KeiPGmX6pJnBbTorL).
